finalText:
Building clean now, exit 0.

Most of that wall of output was just deprecation noise from the bump, harmless. Two real bugs were hiding in it though:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw and killed the build.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` required `backoffEnabled` to be strictly `true` or `false`. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` when unset, so it threw right after the first fix.

Fixed both: `resolveRetries` now reads `retryCount`, and `isBackoffEnabled` treats anything other than `true` as disabled instead of throwing.

Build finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings (all deprecation noise) and 0 errors.
